name: Dibutyltryptamine
summary: Dibutyltryptamine (DBT), also known as N,N-dibutyltryptamine (N,N-DBT), is a psychedelic drug of the tryptamine family related to dimethyltryptamine (DMT).

pharmacology.text: DBT is a serotonin receptor agonist in the rat uterus and rat stomach strip, with similar potency as dimethyltryptamine (DMT). It produces the head-twitch response, a behavioral proxy of psychedelic effects, in mice.
